data_layers.1_raw_source: raw_data/ (StatCan CAD thousands; OECD USD millions) — see SOURCE_MANIFEST.md
data_layers.2_native_validated_statcan: checkpoints/native_detail/<prov>.npz — full 220-commodity x use (basic/purchaser/tax/margins + source split), StatCan IOIC/IOCC, CAD thousands, PRE OECD-50
data_layers.3_mapped_canonical_oecd50: this canonical/ directory — official OECD-50, CAD millions, basic prices

gross_tax_subsidy_resolution: Product taxes: NET (taxes less subsidies) observed at commodity x industry AND commodity x FD (valuation_tax_net_*). GROSS tax vs GROSS subsidy observed ONLY at PRM-aggregate: by industry (intermediate, in VA_tax_output_basic) and by FD-category (final, in product_taxes_final_gross_by_province). Tax-detail workbooks decompose the NET tax by ~20 instruments at commodity x use, but contain no separate gross-subsidy layer, so gross tax/subsidy is NOT available at commodity x use.

files.Z_intermediate_basic.csv: rows=producer (REGION|CODE), cols=user (REGION|CODE); intermediate flows, basic prices
files.FD_by_source_and_category_basic.csv: rows=producer (REGION|CODE), cols=(consumer_region, fd_category in [np.str_('HFCE'), np.str_('NPISH'), np.str_('GGFC'), np.str_('GFCF'), np.str_('INVNT'), np.str_('DPABR')]); final demand attributed to producing region -> source is encoded by producer region (ROW=international)
files.VA_tax_output_basic.csv: rows=industry (REGION|CODE), cols=[wages_salaries, employers_social_contributions, gross_mixed_income, gross_operating_surplus, tax_production, subsidy_production, gross_product_tax_intermediate, gross_product_subsidy_intermediate, net_product_tax_intermediate, output_basic]
files.reexports_by_province_commodity_basic.cs: rows=(region, commodity_i); StatCan re-exports (INTRX000), basic prices. The imported part (capped by INTIM less import use) is excluded from producer rows and import use; the domestic remainder (Canadian trade/transport margins) stays in exports.
files.valuation_{tax_net,margins_trade,margins: rows=(region, commodity i), cols=industry j — FULL commodity x industry structure per province (finest observed)
rows=(region, commodity i), cols=FD category — FULL commodity x FD structure per province
files.note_valuation: Layers preserved verbatim from the raw StatCan sheets at OECD-50 commodity resolution. They follow StatCan margin/tax sign conventions: margin matrices reallocate value across commodities (net negative on goods, offset in trade/transport-service and final-demand cells), so Purchaser is NOT a naive cell-wise sum of Basic+margins+tax. Empirically for the intermediate block Purchaser - Basic = net product tax (-Tax_sheet); the full valuation bridge holds at total-use level across all commodities per StatCan methodology and is NOT re-asserted cell-wise here.

blocks.interprovincial_trade: encoded in Z/FD off-diagonal region blocks (producer province != consumer province); origin-attributed from observed BasicPrice bilateral O-D
blocks.international_imports: ROW producer -> province consumer blocks (Canadian use structure from InternatImportUse)
blocks.valuation_bridge: net_product_tax_intermediate (in VA file) + margins satellites -> reconstruct purchaser prices
